metadata.description: A made-up insurer for trying SimpleArchitecture. Quillfeather Mutual sells home, motor and travel cover directly and through brokers. It is replacing its in-house claims system, QuillClaims, with a bought Claims platform, and its service bus with an API gateway and event streaming. Any likeness to a real company, system or vendor is accidental.
